faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the STPINEXT Manager (Programs), EP-CoE recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the STPINEXT Manager (Programs), EP-CoE recruitment is 10th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Manager (Programs), EP-CoE post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Manager (Programs), EP-CoE post in STPINEXT.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA/Graduate degree from a recognized institute or university with 3 to 8 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years, with relaxation permissible for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Manager (Programs), EP-CoE position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online through the official STPINEXT website.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this post?
faq.answer: The job location is Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

faq.question: Q10. What are the key responsibilities of a Manager (Programs), EP-CoE?
faq.answer: Responsibilities include marketing, brand management, and community building within the corporate, association, incubator, accelerator, or venture fund sectors.
